new_result.statement: For exact rank three and disjoint physical triples S,T, |det A[S,T]|^2=|det A[S,S] det A[T,T]|. Hence ||p_Q||_inf <= 3(|det A[S,S] det A[T,T]|)^(-1/6), retaining arbitrary dense self blocks and outside completion.

continuity_status: The cross-determinant branch has a continuous density by the B09 Fourier theorem; full-target continuity remains open.
unresolved_implication: Aggregate fixed exterior area and triple-volume mass when every pair is small, no two disjoint triples carry quantitative volume, and balanced-cut leverage fails; then handle arbitrary nonseparable additional spectrum.
